items.text:
I can completely relate to this game, pretty much what I think on any date I've been on, its a full on story driven experience, the dialogue is good and the music too
There's a few issues with it
- the sound options are ok, the music sometimes drowns out what your character is saying, but that could be because i have really bad hearing, it works better for me through headphones
-some of the icons which are used for selecting things, i.e pouring wine or eating bread are a little confusing, I think it would have been better to just have words rather than pictures for selecting or maybe they should be bigger icons.
god i sound like i'm 300 years old or something

other than that its fairly funny to listen to this guy saying he wants to shag his date even though she hasn't turned up, I got this in a sale, and that's what I recommend, get it when its on offer, I paid out 40 pence or something for it.
items.text_zh:
我完全能对这款游戏产生共鸣，基本上就是我在任何一次约会中会有的想法，它是一场完整的剧情驱动体验，对话不错，音乐也是
它有几个问题
- 声音选项还行，音乐有时会盖过你的角色在说什么，但那可能是因为我听力真的很差，用耳机对我来说效果更好
- 有些用来选择东西的图标，比如倒酒或吃面包，有点让人困惑，我觉得用文字而不是图片来选择会更好，或者也许它们应该做成更大的图标。
god，我听起来像300岁似的

除此之外，听这家伙说他想上他的约会对象，尽管她根本没出现，还挺好笑的，我是打折时买的，这就是我的推荐，等它打折时再买，我大概花了40便士还是多少买的。

items.text:
It's difficult to really describe Dinner Date without ruining a decent chunk of what makes it worthwhile, but I can safely say it is by far the hipsterest video game the world has ever seen. If you should choose to give it a try, expect an extremely brief (20 minutes or so per my Steam clock), vaguely interactive story-telling exercise, akin to Dear Esther but radically different in scale and style. Also, watch a few dozen britcoms first to attune yourself to British accents (I strongly recommend Black Books), and turn down the music volume a bit while cranking up the dialogue if you intend to have any idea of what's being said. It's by no means a tear-jerker that'll yank at the heart strings, but there's something poignant and sad and empathetic here all the same.

Stand proud, Dinner Date; you will be forever remembered. Perhaps not as the most enjoyable game, and perhaps barely as a game at all, but you've gone and done something Weird and Different, and I can certainly appreciate that.
items.text_zh:
很难在不破坏《Dinner Date》相当一部分价值的情况下真正描述它，但我可以放心地说，它是迄今为止世界上见过的最嬉皮士的电子游戏。如果你选择试一试，那就期待一段极其短暂（按我的Steam计时大约20分钟）、隐约可互动的叙事练习，类似《Dear Esther》，但在规模和风格上截然不同。另外，先看几十部英式喜剧，让自己适应英国口音（我强烈推荐《Black Books》），并且如果你打算听懂到底在说什么，就把音乐音量调低一点，同时把对话音量调高。它绝不是那种会拉扯心弦的催泪作品，但这里仍然有某种辛酸、悲伤和共情的东西。

骄傲地站着吧，《Dinner Date》；你会被永远记住。也许不是作为最令人享受的游戏，也许勉强算作一款游戏，但你确实做了一些怪异而不同的事情，我当然能欣赏这一点。
